svg.title: How the ring buffer works
svg.desc: Animated. An 8-byte ring where WriteByte and ReadByte move the write and read positions around and wrap. Overwrite mode drops the oldest bytes when full; backpressure mode blocks Write until a Read frees room.
svg.text: One fixed slice, two positions that wrap around
New(8) allocates one 8-byte slice. Capacity is a power of two, so
a position wraps with pos & (Cap−1) instead of a modulo.
Write copies bytes in at writePos and moves it forward.
Read copies bytes out from readPos and moves it forward.
One mutex guards both positions. Two sync.Conds wake blocked
readers and writers, each with one reused timer for timeouts.
A single Write larger than Cap() fails with ErrTooLargeForWrite.
A stall past WithWriteTimeout fails with ErrTimeout;
Close or a canceled context wakes the writer.
